scope: Stage-purpose classification and ordering/state constraints for every configured rule placement; not a translation-versus-rewrite decision

contract.contract: Reject unsupported ROW comparisons, window frames and aggregates before later rewrites erase their source shapes.
The retained CorrelateProjectExtractor moves projections while preserving correlation identity and field references.
Call RelDecorrelator after the preceding correlation and set-operation rewrites. Unremoved Correlate shapes remain part of the measured inventory.

stage_contracts.scope: Stage-purpose classification and ordering/state constraints for every configured rule placement; not a translation-versus-rewrite decision
common_contract: Preserve SQL options, metadata, expression and correlation identities, source positions, hints, type/nullability and ordered rule configurations.
Stage 0 and 1 failures abort compilation. Other stages log and skip failed transformations; preserve the original input and failure trace.
Dynamic HEP program builders append rules during apply. Repeated placements and successive view compilations retain their actual step-object lifetimes.
Every configured rule stays in the initial parity scope, including rules with zero measured productions.

steps.contract: RexSubQuery is replaced by Correlate/Join forms; literal aggregate cleanup shares this stage. Every later stage expects these forms.
Reject unsupported ROW comparisons, window frames and aggregates before later rewrites erase their source shapes.
Reduce arguments before table-function rewrites; retain constant-evaluator policy and diagnostics.
Rewrite SESSION before RexOver expansion; generated window expressions feed stage 22.
At level 2, reduce scalar expressions and Values, coerce inputs and simplify joins with single-row inputs. Preserve NULL, overflow and evaluator semantics.
Prune empty inputs with join-side, aggregate-empty-input and set-operation semantics intact.
The retained CorrelateProjectExtractor moves projections while preserving correlation identity and field references.
Only when UNCOLLECT occurs, transpose project/filter, move correlate filters, remove identity projects and merge correlate/uncollect.
Keep MaxCaseToCount before case-to-filter, then NOW filters and MODE-to-ARG_MAX. Filter rewrites must precede MODE handling.
Merge compatible UNION/INTERSECT/MINUS and combine filtered set operations; retain ALL versus DISTINCT and branch order.
Remove redundant sorts and constant keys under ordering and fetch constraints.
Transpose correlate projects and filters while updating correlation field dependencies.
Merge adjacent project, aggregate and set operations; this same step instance returns at stage 30.
Commute right joins to left joins with a projection that preserves output column order.
Bottom-up predicate/expression rewrites precede MultiJoin and bushy search; outer joins or fewer than three joins bypass that search. Lopt remains the fallback.
Level-2 UNNEST decorrelation; retain correlation scopes and optional project forms.
First InnerDecorrelator application; preserve empty-input and correlated aggregate semantics.
Move correlation across UNION before the second inner-query decorrelation.
Repeat InnerDecorrelator after Correlate/Union; do not collapse the two placements.
Level-2 EXCEPT rewrite; preserve multiplicities and NULL equality.
Merge set-operation shapes before ExceptAllFold; ALL multiplicities remain observable.
Call RelDecorrelator after the preceding correlation and set-operation rewrites. Unremoved Correlate shapes remain part of the measured inventory.
Run OVER SUM-to-SUM0 before project-to-project/window expansion; preserve empty sums, constants, frames and window ordering.
Convert eligible ROWS frames after window expansion without changing peer or boundary semantics.
Retain both DISTINCT-expansion configurations and their order; descriptions alone do not identify configurations.
Run only without Correlate or join hints and with more than one join; convert joins to a hypergraph before Dphyp search.
Reuse the stage-14 instance after hypergraph rewriting, including its existing program builder and configured-rule list.
Transpose windows, set operations and filters. Do not re-enable the commented correlate/join project transposes.
Repeat expression pushdown after moving projections, in bottom-up match order.
Bottom-up join/filter/disjunction rewrites; retain repeated rules and match ordering.
Reuse the stage-12 step after pushdown, preserving ordered rule instances.
Remove redundant aggregates, anti-join distincts, unions, projects and eligible joins under their metadata preconditions.
